packages.name: Airtime_Contest
packages.title: Air-time contest
packages.description: Every landing after at least one second in the air counts; the longest goes to the server's board "longest_air" (higher is better) and the top 3 show for a few seconds.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Boost
packages.title: Boost
packages.description: Hold F7 and the rider goes where the camera looks, at a set speed. For getting around a map quickly (a test world, a mod's own terrain). PAGEUP / PAGEDOWN change the speed (10..300 m/s, 60 at the start).
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Camera_Fx
packages.title: Camera effects
packages.description: F6 goes through wide angle, zoom, dutch angle, crane shot, orbit and back to the game's own camera. The effect has to be renewed every frame (it ends 250 ms after the mod stops); the game keeps steering the camera.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Challenge_Example
packages.title: Challenge Example
packages.description: Adds a short test race on the Alps (declared in Lua) and, when switched on, a jump challenge (declared in resteep.json). Shows how mods add challenges of every kind.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Checkpoint_Race
packages.title: Checkpoint race
packages.description: Build a course where you ride, race it, compare times on the server.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Crash_Log
packages.title: Crash log
packages.description: Counts falls per sport, shows the last one and the sport in the top left corner, remembers the counts. Uses the rider events sport_change / crash / crash_end and resteep.sport() (MODDING.md).
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Devtools
packages.title: Dev tools for mod authors
packages.description: F9 writes where you are (position, velocity, air) and the world state to the MODS console and shows it for a moment; hold Ctrl+F9 to keep it on screen.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Domino_Playground
packages.title: Domino playground
packages.description: A Domino script of its own in the Alps: a few seconds after it starts it drops you from the sky.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Domino_Showcase
packages.title: Domino showcase
packages.description: Everything a mod's Domino script can do today, one key each, next to the Alps' tutorial start.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Event_Notify
packages.title: Event notifications
packages.description: Every event ReSteep raises shows a notification (and a line in the MODS console) when it fires. For checking that the events work. "frame" is left out (it fires every frame); "key" shows the key name.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Example_Animation
packages.title: Example: Animations
packages.description: Grabs swapped and sped up: an example of content.animations (docs/modding/animations.md).
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: FPV_Drone
packages.title: FPV drone
packages.description: Launch a drone like the game's own and fly it first-person, also through the game's replays: gamepad or keyboard, d-pad for FOV and camera angle, a model and motor sound.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Framestep
packages.title: Frame step
packages.description: F10 freezes the whole world (the engine's stop mode), "." runs one simulation step, "," ten. F10 again lets it run. The game cuts to its pause camera while frozen.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Golden_Hour
packages.title: Golden hour
packages.description: Ctrl+G holds the light at sunset (19:30, clock paused); Ctrl+G again gives the game its clock back.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Helicopter
packages.title: Helicopter
packages.description: Fly the rider like a helicopter, inside the Alps' own Red Bull helicopter; Alaska gets a copy of it (Japan with an experimental setting), built against your install at game start.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Hello_Config
packages.title: Hello Config
packages.description: Settings test for scripts: press F9 in the game to see the strength you set. Changing a setting writes a line to the console (config_change).
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Lua_Hat_Demo
packages.title: Lua Hat Demo
packages.description: A striped beanie with a pompom, made by a build script (build.lua) from the colours you pick. Shows own models and own textures without a 3D program.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Markers
packages.title: Markers
packages.description: Rings in the world. A ring on you with your speed, and four rings 10 m north/south/east/west at your height. Shows that resteep.marker follows the game's camera (use it with the free camera or the rider turning).
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Master_Chief_Costume
packages.title: Master Chief Costume
packages.description: Master Chief as a costume of his own, owned by every player. You download the model (free, CC-BY); ReSteep fits it to Steep's skeleton on your PC.
packages.author: ReSteep (model: HarrisonHag1)

packages.name: Physics_Playground
packages.title: Physics playground
packages.description: Change the ski and snowboard physics while you ride (resteep.handling): jump, air drag, mass, snow.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: ReSteep_Boxes
packages.title: ReSteep Boxes
packages.description: A wireframe of the space every slot may use: start here before you model your own gear.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: ReSteep_Hill
packages.title: ReSteep Hill
packages.description: A test massif: one smooth snow hill of our own (about 55 m, rollers, banked rims) over the menu world's valley, to ride custom ground. Takes the park's world name: enable one of the two. Built against your install at game start.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: ReSteep_Mountains
packages.title: ReSteep Mountains
packages.description: A map with mountains of its own, generated from a seed in resteep.json: change the seed for another range. Takes the park's world name: enable one of park, hill, terrain test, this.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: ReSteep_Park
packages.title: ReSteep Park
packages.description: A small fourth massif next to the Alps, Asia and Alaska: the menu world's valley with its huts, and Alaska's wooden in-run as a jump. Built against your install at game start.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Rider_Colors
packages.title: Rider Colors
packages.description: Paints your rider's starter backpack and pants in a colour of your choice. Pick the colour and brightness in the settings; changing them needs a game restart, because the game reads its textures at start.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Example_Script
packages.title: Script (example)
packages.description: A Domino script of the mod's own, run by the game's script engine; its Lua lists, stops and starts it.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: Speedometer
packages.title: Speedometer
packages.description: Speed and air time in the bottom right corner. The smallest useful mod.
packages.author: ReSteep

packages.name: GoPro_Stabilized
packages.title: Stabilized GoPro cam
packages.description: Steadies the first-person GoPro head cam: smoothed, the horizon level, a GoPro-like lens.
packages.author: ReSteep
